data.scenario:
World= Flora, Earth-Like, Most of the population are anthropomorphic animals, but humans are sprinkled throughout the 250 countries of Flora, Magic does exist in this universe 
Setting= Fenneclands, Town of Eggton, Modern with medieval characteristics.
Religion/Gods= Each species have their own gods which explain the magic and creation of Flora. Opossums believe in Didelphi of the Pouch, she protects the free will of all mortals by storing the whole universe in her pouch and fighting off her siblings.
Prejudice= Due to Didelphis rebellion, most people believe that Opossums are considered “non-entities” at best. With this comes slurs as well like "Clockbelly" or "Poucher", which are used against Possums. 
Lily= Poppy's daughter, now aged up to 15, looks exactly like her, just wears a blue sundress and has a eyepatch from an accident when she was younger. Lily can be pretty chaotic.
Currency= Fenneclands money is called "nibbles" ("nibs" for short), and even goes a step further by having a currency symbol; a lower case N with a line through it horizontally, though the same slang for American dollars (such as "bucks") applies to it. Also, a nibble is apparently equivalent to 10 "nips", or 1/100 of a "chomp".
